dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? It looks like a transparent curtain is rising all around us... Is that tree doing this?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like it's spewing resin... Paimon thinks it's trying to turn this whole place into a piece of amber!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That would make us the little bugs trapped inside.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: An amber piece with the two of us inside? Paimon bets it would definitely be the star of any auction! We'd be a one-of-a-kind treasure!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then what's the actual crown jewel?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This tree, obviously! It's the one making all this amber, after all. It's a shame we can't just haul it away with us...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon wonders if there are any clues about it nearby.
